name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protecting EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and material
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action. It condemns sex dolls shaped like children and wants a full EU ban on making, importing, storing, selling and delivering them. It also asks for tougher enforcement against online marketplaces selling illegal or unsafe goods, faster investigations, an end to the customs exemption for parcels under 150 euros, and default parental controls on devices.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Online marketplaces, non-EU sellers, EU manufacturers and retailers, parents and children.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
